faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.s1_q: Is Kadam an internship or job site?
faq.s1_a: No. You solve real problems for small businesses and NGOs. When they use your work, the results they report become your impact report.
faq.s2_a: No. Kadam is free for students.
faq.s3_a: Add your college email after you sign up and you're verified straight away. Or upload your student ID, and the Kadam team checks it within 72 hours.
faq.s4_q: What if the business rejects my work?
faq.s4_a: They must write a reason, so you always learn something. If they ask for changes, you can fix it and submit again.
faq.s5_q: What goes in my impact report?
faq.s5_a: A summary, the results the business measured, the skills you showed, a timeline and resume-ready bullet points. Share it as a link or a PDF.
faq.b1_q: What does it cost to post a problem?
faq.b1_a: Nothing. Posting a problem on Kadam is free.
faq.b2_q: Do I need GST, Udyam or Darpan registration?
faq.b2_a: No. An email and a password are enough, so kirana stores, home businesses, startups and NGOs can all join.
faq.b3_q: Can I describe my problem in my own language?
faq.b3_a: Yes. Speak or type in English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Odia, Bengali or Gujarati. Kadam asks a few follow-up questions and writes a clear brief for students.
faq.b4_a: Verified college students. You see how many have taken it up, chat with each one, and can close the problem to new students at any time.
faq.b5_q: What do I need to do after the work arrives?
faq.b5_a: Confirm you received it and set a status. If you use it, share a few lines every two weeks on what changed, like time saved or sales. Kadam reminds you.
